description: Figure 4 is a horizontal bar chart illustrating how many participants (N=6) highlighted each evaluation criterion as beneficial. The vertical axis lists the criteria as categories (top to bottom: “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation”), and the horizontal axis is the value axis labeled “Number of Participants,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to 6 with tick labels at 0, 2, 4, and 6. Each category has a single solid-colored bar with a numeric value label at the bar end: “Relevant FCs” is a dark purple bar at 6, “FC Summary” is a dark blue bar at 5, “Relevance Explanation” is a teal bar at 3, “Clarity and Simplicity” is a teal bar at 3, “Overall Summary” is a green bar at 2, “Filters” is a light green bar at 1, and “Veracity Explanation” is a yellow-green bar at 1. The bars are not shown as grouped or stacked, and there is no legend; the categories appear ordered from higher counts at the top to lower counts at the bottom, with no additional visual emphasis beyond the value labels.
